text: A clootie is a ritual object. The cloth is a rag, a ribbon, or a small piece of fabric, and the wearer binds it to a holy tree, the bile, beside a well. In Ireland and Scotland people first touch the rag to a sore part of the body, then tie it to the tree, so the cloth carries the wish for healing. The custom still lives. In Scotland one tree near a well holds tens of thousands of such strips.

okr.objective: A clootie is a rag tied to a sacred tree by a holy well to seek healing.
